data: Does the accuracy of the line with yellow markers decrease as the value of alpha increases?

The line with yellow markers represents the accuracy of the Radical-enhanced model. The x-axis represents the value of alpha, ranging from 0 to 1. The y-axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.1 to 0.8. The line with yellow markers starts at approximately 0.75 when alpha is 0 and decreases gradually as alpha increases. By the time alpha reaches 1, the accuracy of the line with yellow markers has decreased significantly. Therefore, the accuracy of the line with yellow markers does indeed decrease as the value of alpha increases.
